title: Netflix’s TV games get a big boost with Jackbox collection
summary: A screenshot from the PC version of Quiplash 3. Netflix's party-focused lineup of TV games just got three excellent new additions: Jackbox's Drawful 2, Fibbage 4, and Quiplash 3, available as the Jackbox Party Essentials pack on the platform.
